justification: AJ Brown's tagged Out, not Doubtful, not Questionable — that's the one that actually sits a man, no debate, no eulogy, and with Josh Downs healthy and dressed on my own bench there's no case for leaving a corpse in the lineup to make a point. Downs steps into WR1 off real snaps against Indy. Everything else stays exactly where it is because it isn't broken: Caleb doesn't sit for anybody's projection, Brissett's 18.41 on paper or not — we don't stream the position, we have a quarterback. Jeanty and Judkins take the top off, Pollard's riding the hot hand after a 35-point Sunday nobody saw coming, Burden and Goedert earned their snaps, and the kicker and the Lions D round out a lineup that doesn't need redecorating. We don't tank a bye-week ghost into a starting job and we don't bench production to chase a feeling — we cobble together the best eight men standing and go to work.
